description: This file defines the ReadableOrderList class, a Java entity used to represent a list of orders with total count and list of ReadableOrder objects, extending ServiceEntity and implementing Serializable.

classes.name: ReadableOrderList
classes.description: A Java class representing a list of orders with total count, extending ServiceEntity and implementing Serializable.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders.

methods.name: setTotal
methods.description: Sets the total number of orders.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableOrder objects.

methods.name: setOrders
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableOrder objects.
